title: Classic Algerian Chicken Tagine
description: A traditional North African dish made with tender chicken, exotic spices, and a flavorful tagine sauce. This recipe is perfect for a hearty dinner.

ingredients.name: Algerian tagine spice blend
ingredients.notes: available at most Middle Eastern markets

ingredients.name: Exotic spices
ingredients.notes: a mix of cumin, coriander, and cinnamon

instructions: Heat the oil in the bottom of a clay or ceramic tagine over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the chicken to the tagine and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the Algerian tagine spice blend and exotic spices to the tagine and stir to combine.
Pour in 1 cup of water and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Add the chopped dried apricots to the tagine and continue to simmer, covered, until the chicken is cooked through and the sauce has thickened, about 20-25 minutes.
Season the tagine with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley and lemon wedges, if desired.
